title: VeloraOS 1.10.26 - Automatic Web + Lockdown Mode
releaseNotes: VeloraOS now decides automatically when web research is useful; the Web Auto, Web On and Web Off selector has been removed.
Adds a shield-based Lockdown mode persisted in each user account settings.
Lockdown is enforced server-side and prevents all shared Web API searches and external page fetching while enabled.
Removes visible web source cards, external source links and numbered citation styling from Chat responses.
Preserves fast parallel web research, privacy safeguards, SSRF protection, empty-answer recovery and local Ollama inference.
